title: Lutra: complete approved-source migration, two native QGIS projects and independent handover

task.name: Deliver the selected complete vector migration and its two editable QGIS projects
task.purpose: Give the selected migration customer usable native data, editable maps and publications, a complete mapping workbook and an independently reopened operating workspace, using the original baseline and corrected source editions.
task.request: Continue the original Lutra Workshare and Installation. Select up to ten authorized vector layers, two actual QGIS project definitions, the complete baseline export and one corrected-source set. Retain every original record and explicit field, key, null, geometry and CRS decision. Build the selected native GeoPackage and supported Shapefile outputs, prepare the customer's PostGIS import handover, bind both native QGIS projects and publish their agreed layouts. Complete the baseline review, receive the corrected edition, compare and retain both editions, independently reopen the full handover and deliver two operator sessions of up to one hour each.
task.completeOutput: The complete original source and license inventory, source selections and captures, editable mapping plan plus separate XLSX mapping workbook, native vector files and required sidecars, PostGIS import handover manifest, two QGIS projects with styles/resources, selected QGZ/QPT/PDF/PNG publications, original review and correction history, full workspace/application archive, independent native receiving result and editable operating/support handover.
task.repeatTrigger: The original migration includes one baseline and one approved corrected-source edition. A later source edition, additional project/layer or managed operation follows a separately selected useful customer requirement and its agreed scope. Reopening a map, downloading the same archive, repeating a saved query or recovering an interrupted operation continues the existing edition.
task.pricedUnit: Use the original migration Workshare for the implementation fee and its scope/start, baseline and receiving/handover milestones. A selected Stellar resource acquisition uses its separately approved complete source/result unit, original atomic price and spending authority. Retain multiple underlying requests against their common useful result when that source contract charges them separately.

source.reference: The original customer's complete approved GeoJSON/vector source-selection inventory, actual local source root, baseline and one corrected-source capture, mapping decisions, two project definitions and licensed styles/resources. Maintained product entry: products/gis-migration/OPERATING.md.
source.population: Every selected source feature and field in the agreed up-to-ten-layer inventory, with complete local source files, original byte counts/hashes, selected records and geometry. Retain both original source captures, their complete comparison and every row needed by the agreed two-project result.
source.meaning: Keep exact source numeric and nested values, field names, feature and business-key identity, null/required-value rules, geometry/null policy, observed or assigned source CRS, transformation and target CRS. A destination representation can change key equality or supported value range; retain that explicit reviewed decision with its original rows. Preserve layer/resource bindings, project order/views, styles, print settings and attribution.
source.changePolicy: Receive the corrected source as a separate capture while preserving the baseline. Draft from the retained predecessor plan, review changed fields, keys, geometry/CRS and project selections, then build a named successor edition and publication. Retain source issues, reviewer decisions and earlier outputs. Further source systems, layers, projects, formats or operating cadence follow the original Workshare change process.

receiving.application: The existing Applications → GIS migration product, its original migration workspace, migration-operator and migration-workspace commands, and the installed vector/QGIS engines. Bind the actual Operator Python, Fiona/GDAL Vector Python and QGIS Python, selected source release, private runtime and receiving directories.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Receive the original Workshare, full source inventory and approved mapping. Build and natively reopen the selected baseline vector outputs; open both complete QGIS projects and their editable/publication files; retain the consolidated baseline review; receive one corrected source and its reviewed successor; independently receive the complete workspace/application archive and reopen the actual maps/publications; export the received workspace onward and complete the original operator handover.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The migration customer owns source rights, final mapping and target choices, approved styles/resources and production database/GeoServer administration. Lutra retains its customer relationship and selected architecture. The installation operator owns the selected local workspace and native environment; the source publisher owns later source editions. A source withdrawal or changed destination keeps its original license/history and receives an explicit operational decision.
receiving.recovery: Open the saved original request with its complete command, payload, workspace ID, actor, revision and request ID. Recover committed results through that same operation; preserve completed map/publication subrequests. Use the original complete archive and receiving request on interruption, resume the same verified byte prefix and retain both source and received workspace identities. Reopen the same Applications workspace after a process restart.
receiving.maintenance: Name the migration lead, source/rights owner, mapping reviewer, payer, native runtime owner and receiving operator. Retain selected versions, private connections, source and export locations, original correction scope, two review rounds and two operator sessions. Customer infrastructure, source/software licenses and ongoing managed operation remain assigned in the original agreement; keep its change estimates, source ownership and complete editable handover together.

steps.title: Bind the original migration and complete source scope
steps.result: Continue the retained Workshare/Installation and select the actual layer inventory, baseline and corrected-source set, data sizes, two project definitions, source-use rights, named reviewers/payer and destination. Keep its original 60-hour five-phase effort, twelve-business-day schedule and proposed milestones.

steps.title: Open the original installed GIS workspace
steps.result: Select the actual maintained product release, original workspace ID, Operator/Vector/QGIS Python environments, private native request and handover locations. Open that workspace through the existing Applications operation and inspect its actual source/operation state.

steps.title: Review mapping and deliver complete baseline data
steps.result: Receive the original source-selection bytes and every selected feature. Save the complete mapping, resolve field/key/null/geometry/CRS and destination choices, deliver the separate editable XLSX mapping workbook and retain the full issue index. Build and natively reopen GeoPackage and selected supported Shapefile outputs; prepare the PostGIS import handover.

steps.title: Build both maps and complete baseline review
steps.result: Bind the two actual project definitions, complete native data, styles and resources. Open both QGIS projects, save reviewed layouts and publish the selected QGZ/QPT/PDF/PNG files with attribution. Retain the original consolidated baseline review and current project/publication identities.

steps.title: Receive and review the corrected source edition
steps.result: Capture the one included corrected-source set, compare all affected records, save the reviewed successor plan and rebuild the selected data, projects and publications. Keep baseline and corrected editions available with explicit changes, native readback and the consolidated final review.

steps.title: Independently receive and reopen the whole project
steps.result: Export the complete original workspace and selected application. Receive the whole archive into the named separate location, verify its original source/workspace selections and open the actual native data, maps and publications through the delivered application. Reopen in Applications and export the received workspace onward through its original receiving route.

steps.title: Complete the editable operator handover
steps.result: Deliver original sources/licenses, editable JSON and XLSX mappings, native data/maps/layouts/publications, PostGIS handover, saved requests, complete archives and guides. Complete both agreed operator sessions, repeat the actual customer workflow and record correction, runtime, source, production loading and ongoing support ownership in the original case.

inputs: Complete original Lutra commissioning-inputs JSON and matching receiving packet when present, original Workshare case/plan digest and the latest existing Installation/case selection
Approved complete source-selection inventory and actual source root, up to ten layers, the baseline and one corrected-source set, original bytes/hashes and source/data/software rights
Agreed data sizes, source/destination formats and runtime versions, field/key/null and geometry/CRS rules, complete editable mapping plan and separate XLSX mapping workbook
Two complete QGIS project definitions with selected layers, styles/fonts/resources, saved views, intended layouts, print settings and attribution
Original installed GIS product, original workspace ID, actual Operator/Vector/QGIS Python paths and versions, private native request/connection and handover directories
Named migration lead, reviewer, payer, receiving engineer and independent receiving host; original commercial phase owners, effort, milestone terms and correction/session scope
Complete baseline/corrected native outputs, project/publication history, PostGIS import handover, original archive/manifest and native/merchant receiving selections
Actual source/resource purchase selections when used: original merchant/buyer deployments, complete useful priced unit, atomic amount/task budget, network/asset/recipient and authority
